title: ImpliHateVid: A Benchmark Dataset and Two-stage Contrastive Learning Framework for Implicit Hate Speech Detection in Videos
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for detecting implicit hate speech, which is a task fundamentally rooted in evaluating content based on moral and ethical harms. The annotation guidelines and the definition of hate speech used in the paper specifically include religion as a protected characteristic, and the dataset is used to evaluate how well models can identify such ethically sensitive and harmful content.
